parsed.summary: Router r2 connects to routers r1 and r3 via eth1 and eth4 respectively, providing Layer 3 connectivity to client (eth1) and server segments (eth2), as well as a management segment (eth3). It forwards IP packets and has static routes configured for reaching client (10.0.1.0/24), DMZ (10.0.3.0/24), and sensor networks (10.0.4.0/24) via r1 and r3.
